decision.why: mark.mjs needs something typeable; existing 16 lines all share one `at`, titles are unique
decision.alt: at+title pair as the id (brief default; unusable on a command line)

decision.what: the fold lives in public/framework/ai/asks/fold.js, imported by Servex/asks/Asks.js by relative path and by ai2/needs.js
decision.why: one fold for server and browser, the same precedent as Cards.js importing ai2/fold.js
decision.alt: a GET /asks route; breaks on the static site

decision.what: close_task → landed via Asks wrapping servex.task_loop.close_task at install, plus the tick reading the owner's task.jsonl for landed_at
decision.why: fence allows one line in Servex.js and nothing in TaskLoop.js

decision.what: Inbox rows show an importance badge only; Needs you is re-ranked by importance, the Inbox keeps newest-first
decision.why: brief says inbox.js 'score only', and the owner asked earlier for newest card on top
decision.alt: rank the Inbox by importance too
